question: Which Compare page layout? Today the question shows twice: in the round tier and as the page heading. A is today. B and C drop the heading and keep the answer in view: B in a right sidebar, C in a bottom bar. Scroll inside each screen and try picking.

variants.label: Today (control)
variants.changes: Copy of today's CompareScreen and AnswerPanel: round badges, the question as a big heading, tabs with the view switch, the frame, then the answer panel below it (pick, tags, reason, submit).

variants.label: No heading, answer sidebar
variants.changes: The heading goes; the round tier carries the question. The same answer panel sits in a 320px right sidebar that stays put while the page scrolls. Tests whether answering next to the frame beats answering under it.

variants.label: No heading, bottom bar
variants.changes: The heading goes; the frame fills the screen. Pick, tags and reason sit in one row in a bar pinned to the bottom. Tags fold into a menu so the row fits. Tests the most room for the variant with the least answer chrome.
